distance_note: These are distances from the exact profile origins to stored destination access coordinates, using the existing straight-line range gate. additional_candidates_reviewed.name: Bravo Farm / Langub trail-event routes
additional_candidates_reviewed.evidence: UTMB records confirm the Adobo Urban Trail Run was held in Barangay Langub on 9 August 2026. This verifies an organised event, not walk-in public hiking access on 4-5 November. The specific public trailhead, non-event permission, visitor hours, return route and fees remain unconfirmed. Do not turn an event course into an automatically available short hike.

additional_candidates_reviewed.name: Devil's Trail — Long
additional_candidates_reviewed.evidence: A contributor route record documents a very difficult downhill mountain-bike singletrack. It does not establish current public hiking permission, visitor facilities or a suitable short hiking product. A bike route must not be relabelled as a verified tourist hike merely to cover the requested interest.

additional_candidates_reviewed.name: Shrine Hills proposed eco-tourism trails
additional_candidates_reviewed.evidence: The advocacy and development documents describe proposed canopy walks and hiking connectors. They do not verify that those visitor trails were built and are currently open. Existing shrine and viewpoint visits remain distinct from a verified hiking trail.

additional_candidates_reviewed.name: Times Beach / coastal-road frontage
additional_candidates_reviewed.evidence: A Philippine Reclamation Authority site report describes loss of the former bathing area. Recent government reporting identifies the Times Beach-Roxas coastal-road segment. A surf-clothing retailer's current Times Beach address confirms a shop, not an accessible swimming/sandy beach. No new beach entrance was verified.

enablement_requirements: A named real beach or hiking trail within the exact 5 km origin radius, not a neighborhood centroid or an inaccessible summit point
Recent operator, land-manager or public-authority evidence of visitor access on the requested dates, including any appointment or permit requirement
A road-accessible entrance and honest onward walking/ferry transfers
Budget eligibility that includes mandatory admission, guides and permits; unknown tariffs remain unknown
Visit scheduling that preserves opening windows, meal breaks, daily travel limits and hotel proximity
